dialogues.jp: 今日も一日なんとか無事に終わった。
dialogues.en: "...I'd be off first.", Kanae's voice called out to me.
dialogues.text: "...I'd be off first.", Kanae's voice called out to me.

dialogues.jp:
『……じゃ、お先に』と声をかけてきた叶に笑
いかえす。
dialogues.en: "Okay. ...Take care on your way back."
dialogues.text: "Okay. ...Take care on your way back."

dialogues.jp: 「うん。……気をつけて帰れよな」
dialogues.en: I answered back with a smile.
dialogues.text: I answered back with a smile.

dialogues.jp:
……本当なら一緒に下校したい所だが『家の者
に見られたらまずい』という叶の言葉でそれだ
けは叶わなかった。
dialogues.en:
... I would've wanted to walk back from school together, but
as she said, "If anyone at home sees us, we're dead."
dialogues.text:
... I would've wanted to walk back from school together, but
as she said, "If anyone at home sees us, we're dead."

dialogues.jp:
（最近、ちょっと疲れてるみたいだし……大丈
　夫かな）
dialogues.en:
"(She's been looking tired lately... I wonder if she's
feeling alright.)"
dialogues.text:
"(She's been looking tired lately... I wonder if she's
feeling alright.)"

dialogues.jp:
俺は教室を出て行く細い後姿をなんとなく心配
な気持ちで見送っていた。
dialogues.en:
I glanced at the thin figure leaving the classroom, my
worried feelings serving as a farewell.
dialogues.text:
I glanced at the thin figure leaving the classroom, my
worried feelings serving as a farewell.

dialogues.jp: （さて……俺もそろそろ帰ろうか）
dialogues.en: "(Hm... it's about time for me to leave as well.)"
dialogues.text: "(Hm... it's about time for me to leave as well.)"

dialogues.jp:
よっこらしょ、と鞄を肩にかつぎあげる。とは
言え教科書の類は机の中に置きっぱなしで、ほ
とんど中身は入っていないのだが。
dialogues.en:
I hosited my bag onto my shoulder and got ready. Normally
I'd just stuff it inside my desk, but it's filled to the
brim already.
dialogues.text:
I hosited my bag onto my shoulder and got ready. Normally
I'd just stuff it inside my desk, but it's filled to the
brim already.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ジャストアモーメントォッ！」
dialogues.en: "Just one moment!"
dialogues.text: "Just one moment!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Wah!?"
dialogues.text: "Wah!?"

dialogues.jp: いきなり首根っこを後ろから強引に引かれる。
dialogues.en: Something grabbed the collar of my shirt from behind.
dialogues.text: Something grabbed the collar of my shirt from behind.

dialogues.jp:
なんなんだ、と振り向くとそこには杉並がいわ
くありげな表情で立っていた。
dialogues.en:
I instinctively turned around to find Suginami with his
usual annoyingly-cheerful expression on his face.
dialogues.text:
I instinctively turned around to find Suginami with his
usual annoyingly-cheerful expression on his face.

dialogues.jp:
「なんだよ、杉並？　俺、これから帰るとこな
　んだが」
dialogues.en: "What is it, Suginami? I'm just going home."
dialogues.text: "What is it, Suginami? I'm just going home."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「待て待て、朝倉。親友としてお前に忠告すべ
　きことがあるのだ」
dialogues.en:
"Wait wait, Asakura. I have a warning to give you, as a good
friend."
dialogues.text:
"Wait wait, Asakura. I have a warning to give you, as a good
friend."

dialogues.jp: ヘンに神妙な口調で切り出す杉並。
dialogues.en: A weirdly meek tone, considering it's from him.
dialogues.text: A weirdly meek tone, considering it's from him.

dialogues.jp: 「だ、だからなんなんだよ」
dialogues.en: "L, like I said, what is it?"
dialogues.text: "L, like I said, what is it?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は警戒しつつ、こわごわと答えた。
dialogues.en: I answered, his use of the word "warning" unnerving me.
dialogues.text: I answered, his use of the word "warning" unnerving me.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前も、つくづく罪作りな男だな」
dialogues.en: "You are the scum of the earth."
dialogues.text: "You are the scum of the earth."

dialogues.jp:
なんだか突拍子も無い言葉に、思わず首をかし
げる。
dialogues.en: His sudden, grandoise exclamation threw me off.
dialogues.text: His sudden, grandoise exclamation threw me off.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「先頃俺は、着物姿の美少女と共にいるお前の
　姿を見かけたのだ」
dialogues.en:
"I've recently spotted you together with a beautiful girl in
a kimono."
dialogues.text:
"I've recently spotted you together with a beautiful girl in
a kimono."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: （うげ）

俺はなんとか努力して喉の奥から出かかった声
を飲み込んだ。
dialogues.en:
It took all my effort to swallow my voice down, and not gasp
out loud.
dialogues.text:
It took all my effort to swallow my voice down, and not gasp
out loud.

dialogues.jp:
桜公園でのデート……｛こいつ／杉並｝に目撃されていたと
は。
dialogues.en:
That date at the Sakura Park... this bastard was spying on
us.
dialogues.text:
That date at the Sakura Park... this bastard was spying on
us.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「現在の恋人に悪いとは思わんのか？　この浮
　気者が！！」
dialogues.en:
"Do you not care about your current lover anymore?! You
unfaithful scum!"
dialogues.text:
"Do you not care about your current lover anymore?! You
unfaithful scum!"

dialogues.jp: びしっと顔面を指差し、俺を断罪する。
dialogues.en: His accusatory finger shot out at my face.
dialogues.text: His accusatory finger shot out at my face.

dialogues.jp: 「げ、現在の恋人？？」
dialogues.en: "C, current lover!?"
dialogues.text: "C, current lover!?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「とぼけるな、王子様のことだ」
dialogues.en: "Don't act dumb, I mean your prince."
dialogues.text: "Don't act dumb, I mean your prince."

dialogues.jp: そう言って杉並はにやりと笑った。
dialogues.en: Suginami's expression changed to a smug grin.
dialogues.text: Suginami's expression changed to a smug grin.

dialogues.jp:
「工藤のことか……って、その呼び方はやめろ
　よ」
dialogues.en: "Kudou you mean... kuh, stop calling him that."
dialogues.text: "Kudou you mean... kuh, stop calling him that."

dialogues.jp: しかし、杉並は俺の言葉を無視して続ける。
dialogues.en:
But Suginami completely ignored my words, and continued with
his conviction.
dialogues.text:
But Suginami completely ignored my words, and continued with
his conviction.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お前に焦がれる王子様ひとりを残してさっさ
　と女なんぞに乗り換えるとは……男好きの風
　上にも置けぬ奴だ！」
dialogues.en:
"Leaving your prince alone and replacing him with a girl...
your homosexuality comes and goes with the wind!"
dialogues.text:
"Leaving your prince alone and replacing him with a girl...
your homosexuality comes and goes with the wind!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「だぁッ！　俺は男好きを自称した覚えはな
　い！」
dialogues.en: "What! I don't remember ever calling myself a homo!"
dialogues.text: "What! I don't remember ever calling myself a homo!"

dialogues.jp:
コイツの頭の中で、俺はいったいどんな大変な
ことになっているのやら。
dialogues.en:
What kind of messed up ideas does this guy have of me in his
head?
dialogues.text:
What kind of messed up ideas does this guy have of me in his
head?

dialogues.jp:
「だいたいお前は根本から間違ってる。いいか、
　あの｛こ／娘｝はだな……」
dialogues.en:
"And in the first place, your accusation is false. That girl
is..."
dialogues.text:
"And in the first place, your accusation is false. That girl
is..."

dialogues.jp: と思わず言いかけて、俺は口をつぐんだ。
dialogues.en: As I realized what I was saying, I cut ymself off midspeech.
dialogues.text: As I realized what I was saying, I cut ymself off midspeech.

dialogues.jp: （いかんいかん）
dialogues.en: "(I can't, I can't!)"
dialogues.text: "(I can't, I can't!)"

dialogues.jp:
こんなところで事情をバラしてしまう訳にはい
かない。
dialogues.en: I have no reason to explain the circumstances here.
dialogues.text: I have no reason to explain the circumstances here.

dialogues.jp: …………しかも、よりによって杉並に。
dialogues.en: ...But then, this is Suginami we're talking about.
dialogues.text: ...But then, this is Suginami we're talking about.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……あの｛こ／娘｝は――何だ？」
dialogues.en: "That girl is.... what, hmm?"
dialogues.text: "That girl is.... what, hmm?"

dialogues.jp:
ここぞとばかりに言葉尻を捉え、執拗に追及す
る杉並。
dialogues.en:
Picking up that I had said too much, he continued pushing
the issue.
dialogues.text:
Picking up that I had said too much, he continued pushing
the issue.

dialogues.jp: 俺を見くびるなよ、とでも言いたげな様子だ。
dialogues.en: He's challenging me to explain myself, this guy...
dialogues.text: He's challenging me to explain myself, this guy...

dialogues.en: "Uh... that's..."
dialogues.text: "Uh... that's..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「その？」
dialogues.en: "That's?"
dialogues.text: "That's?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「いや……だから……要するになんだ」
dialogues.en: "No... I mean... that doesn't matter anyway."
dialogues.text: "No... I mean... that doesn't matter anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「要するにって、何も要してはおらんが」
dialogues.en: "If that doesn't matter, then nothing does."
dialogues.text: "If that doesn't matter, then nothing does."

dialogues.jp: ……あぁ、こんなに厳しい杉並は初めてだ。
dialogues.en: ...Geez, this is the first time I've seen him so severe.
dialogues.text: ...Geez, this is the first time I've seen him so severe.

dialogues.jp:
いつまで経っても要領を得ない俺の答えに、杉
並は深く溜息をついた。
dialogues.en:
He'd usually just take my nonsense with a similarly stupid
counter, but all he did now was sigh.
dialogues.text:
He'd usually just take my nonsense with a similarly stupid
counter, but all he did now was sigh.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、あの女の子についてはこれ以上追及す
　るまい」
dialogues.en:
"Well, knowing who that girl is doesn't do anything for
solving this crime."
dialogues.text:
"Well, knowing who that girl is doesn't do anything for
solving this crime."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: （ふぅ……助かった）
dialogues.en: "(Whew... safe.)"
dialogues.text: "(Whew... safe.)"

dialogues.jp:
一時はどうなることかと思ったぜ。俺はこっそ
りと袖で冷や汗を拭った。
dialogues.en:
I had thought of everything I could in that moment. I swept
the cold sweat off my forehead with my sleeve.
dialogues.text:
I had thought of everything I could in that moment. I swept
the cold sweat off my forehead with my sleeve.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……とにかく、無垢なる少年を迷わせた責任
　だけは取らねばならんぞ」
dialogues.en:
"...Not that this young man who's lost his purity has any
intention of trying to."
dialogues.text:
"...Not that this young man who's lost his purity has any
intention of trying to."

dialogues.jp: まだそんなことを言っている杉並。
dialogues.en: And he's still talking about that.
dialogues.text: And he's still talking about that.

dialogues.jp: 俺は拳を繰り出した。
dialogues.en: My hand clenched into a fist.
dialogues.text: My hand clenched into a fist.

dialogues.jp: 「だぁーから！　そうじゃないつってんだろ！」
dialogues.en: "I told you! That's not how it is!"
dialogues.text: "I told you! That's not how it is!"

dialogues.jp:
器用に身体をくねらせてパンチを避けた杉並は、
くるりと一回転して敬礼のようなポーズをキメ
た。
dialogues.en:
He skillfully dodged my punch, did a 360 degree rotation,
and a quick salute.
dialogues.text:
He skillfully dodged my punch, did a 360 degree rotation,
and a quick salute.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「忠告はしたからな、罪深き友よ」
dialogues.en: "My warning has been given, my sinful friend."
dialogues.text: "My warning has been given, my sinful friend."

dialogues.jp:
｛めちゃくちゃ／滅茶苦茶｝格好つけたまま、「いいか、気をつけ
ろよ！」なんて言葉を残し、｛さっそう／颯爽｝とした足取り
で去っていく。
dialogues.en:
With an air of superiority, he chatised me one more time
before leaving in the other direction.
dialogues.text:
With an air of superiority, he chatised me one more time
before leaving in the other direction.

dialogues.jp: 「……なんなんだよアミーゴ」
dialogues.en: "...The hell was that about, amigo."
dialogues.text: "...The hell was that about, amigo."

dialogues.jp:
その姿が見えなくなると、あまりの脱力感に俺
はそばの机に突っ伏してしまった。
dialogues.en:
Exhausted, I fell back into my chair, watching his figure
disappear out the classroom.
dialogues.text:
Exhausted, I fell back into my chair, watching his figure
disappear out the classroom.

dialogues.jp: ◆目撃者◆
dialogues.en: ◆Spy◆
dialogues.text: ◆Spy◆

dialogues.jp:
放課後、杉並に呼び止められ、昨日一緒にいた
着物美少女は誰だ？　浮気はいかん、などと訳
のわからない事を言われた。
dialogues.en:
After school, Suginami called out to me and asked who was
the girl I was with yesterday. I told him that I wasn't
cheating on anyone.
dialogues.text:
After school, Suginami called out to me and asked who was
the girl I was with yesterday. I told him that I wasn't
cheating on anyone.

dialogues.jp: 俺は完璧に男スキーになっているらしいな……。
dialogues.en: He completely things that I'm gay now...
dialogues.text: He completely things that I'm gay now...
